note: mapping_basis=data_labels: item codes are the .sav column names ips03a-ips03i (the .do does rename *, lower and uses the column name as item; core model s3 pattern 1). Each column carries an SPSS variable label with the sub-question wording (leading space trimmed) and value labels 1 Sí / 2 No / 99 Ns/Nc; 9/9 variable labels equal the shipped item_text up to ellipsis form, and the questionnaire (chapter 3, question 3, 3a-3i) and documentation PDF (pp.17-18, IPS03a-IPS03i) print all 9 exactly as shipped. RESP: the .do (Bookmark 2: disorder) sets 99 to missing and reverses (resp = 3 - x), so live resp 2 = Sí, 1 = No. Route 9 checked anyway: raw .sav counts reversed per the .do equal live item x resp counts in 18/18 cells (resp2/resp1: ips03a 13415/14681; b 9262/18869; c 18886/9348; d 14628/11460; e 7717/15375; f 11443/16727; g 13718/15161; h 2411/23409; i 7211/21203). Ns/Nc (1207/1172/1069/3215/6211/1133/424/3483/889) is absent from the table; no system-missing, the question is asked of every respondent; 29072 of 29303 records appear. TEXT (text_source=study_materials): instructions = the questionnaire question 3 stem verbatim, identical in the documentation PDF. item_text = the sub-questions as printed, keeping the leading ellipsis each carries as a continuation of the stem, and keeping the source mix of three-dot (3a, 3e, 3f) and single-character ellipsis (the rest) literally, not normalised. Source inconsistency: the .sav variable label for ips03b reads ...bandas violentas? (three dots) while the questionnaire and documentation both print …bandas violentas? (single character); the questionnaire form is shipped. option_text = value labels as printed (Sí/No), which match the questionnaire response grid. Not shipped: the chapter legend *Ahora me gustaría hacerle algunas preguntas acerca de sus opiniones sobre seguridad.*, which introduces question 1 of the chapter rather than question 3. Single section_id, no section_prompt. language=Spanish; translation_source=machine_translation: INDEC publishes the ENV 2017 in Spanish only; English in the _translated columns produced by IRW (focos rendered lamps; porteros eléctricos rendered door intercoms; hubo rendered there were). Issues-page entry owed once live. STEP 3b: dictionary Description (whether each disorder problem is present in the neighborhood) and the .do comment match IPS03a-i; 9 live items = 9 sub-questions, binary resp matches the Sí/No grid.
